claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Negative Mass Propulsion", series "Defense Futures", published 2011-01-03 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2010-08-30, DIA document number DIA-08-1101-023. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.
Cover page reads: '03 January 2011 / ICOD 30 August 2010 / DIA-08-1101-023 / Defense Intelligence Reference Document / Defense Futures / Negative Mass Propulsion'.

Attributed on the DIA list of AATIP/AAWSAP products supplied to the Senate Armed Services Committee to 'Dr F Winterberg, Univ of Nevada-Reno'. The author line on the released PDF is redacted under (b)(6).

Administrative note: 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2010 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program.' Held in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

connections.label: Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program (AAWSAP)
connections.note: The released document names the programme itself. Its inside cover reads 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency ... Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program' - the redaction between them is (b)(3):10 USC 424. Verified by downloading this DIRD and scanning its full text on 23 August 2026. The scans are OCR-degraded, so the quotation is normalised from the damaged rendering.

connections.note: Bigelow Aerospace Advanced Space Studies held the DIA contract under which the DIRDs were produced and subcontracted the individual authors; the DIA cover letter to SASC describes the list as 'all products produced under the AATIP contract'. Tier 2 rather than tier 1 because the contractor name is redacted under (b)(3):10 USC 424 on the DIRD cover page itself, so the subcontracting chain for this specific paper is inferred from the programme structure rather than read off the document.
